word:quran.title: The Quran
word:quran.note: The Quran's name for itself: a recitation. It first means what is being recited to Muhammad, then the whole.

entries.text: qurʾān (قُرْءان): recitation; the Quran. 70 times in 69 verses.
qaraʾa (قَرَأَ): to recite, to read. 16 times in 15 verses.

word:qibla.title: The direction of prayer
word:qibla.note: The qibla. 2:142-150 turns it from the earlier direction, which the Quran does not name, to the Sacred Mosque.

entries.text: qibla (قِبْلَة): direction faced in prayer. 7 times in 5 verses.
